newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PSV LOSE NILIS FOR FEYENOORD CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PSV LOSE NILIS FOR FEYENOORD CLASH.

text.p: PSV Eindhoven will be without Belgian striker Luc Nilis for the top-of-the-table clash with Feyenoord on Sunday, Dutch ANP news agency said on Friday.
The player has still not recovered from an ankle injury sustained two weeks ago.
Nilis is the league's top scorer with 15 goals. He was also last season's leading striker and was named Player of the Year in Belgium and the Netherlands in 1996.
PSV's creative midfielder Wim Jonk was another injury worry. He limped out of Friday's training session but was expected to be fit again by Sunday.
Meanwhile, fellow midfielder Marciano Vink, who has a long-term thigh injury, left hospital on Friday. He is yet to resume training and was not expected to start.
